about: The painted backdrop beyond the walkable area (map/BUILDING.md: painting, not models). tools/backdrop.mjs restyles each panel from the scroll strip that lies past that edge (scan: a rect u0,v0,u1,v1, or several joined side by side) with prompts/backdrop_panel.txt + the panel's content prompt (prompts/backdrop_gate_<side>.txt): seen at eye level on plain white, which ship keys out with clean edges; it measures the painted horizon, and web/src/backdrop.js stands the panel on the ring (angles: 0 = east, 90 = north, 180 = west) at its true aspect with that horizon at eye level, its foot in ground mist. Everything outside the painted area is veiled in mist (the scroll's blank silk). South (toward the viewer, below the silk's edge) the scroll paints nothing: mist only, no panel. East and west drop out when their neighbour is loaded (the joined world).

panels.picked: 2026-10-12, draw 3, made after the content prompt gained its pollard-willow sentence (candidates 0-1; the images are also in gen/sections/gate/backdrop/draw3_2026-10-12). Draws 1-2 (draw1_2026-10-12, draw2_2026-10-12; the earlier pick was draw 2's first) all wept their willows and are no longer candidates. 0 holds what the strip paints: dark pines; stalls under woven-mat awnings with dark parasols; the temple's tiled gate hall up the open ground; the earthen wall topped with crossed spikes, with its small tiled gate building and soldiers idling in front; the fortune-teller's awning with a hanging signboard beside a pollard; the covered cart and its oxen with a man on foot; the rider with a round fan; porters with shoulder poles; the striped banner pole; the thatched hut; the tea house and the long tiled halls on the right. Its willows are pollards with stiff shoots, not weeping. Its departures: the bank under the temple is grassed green (the strip's is bare earth); the pollards stand in a row of five or six down the right side and on to the far end (the strip has a few bare trees there); and no pollard has the huge dark burled trunk. 1 is rejected: its wall has no crossed spikes and runs on to the horizon like a city wall, with a second gate tower at its far end, and its rider holds no fan (he wears a wide hat). Both paint the road as a deep wedge (ground strip 0.076 and 0.074 of the width), so the page lifts the panel like the old one
panels.why: S4 part 1 (the outer road, u 9400-12600) lies past the east seam; shown only when the outer road is not loaded

panels.picked: 2026-10-12: 0 paints only bare level ground, low earth mounds, bare fan-twig trees with a haze of shoots and leaning pines, closer together on the right, as the top band does; 1 adds weeping willows and green shrubs. Held at first because the keyer turned its bare crowns white (37% of the visible pixels near-white); shipped on 2026-10-12 after the keyer's edge matte (gen/expand/backdrop_lessons.md, the keyer), at 8% near-white (pale ground and a few pale bud dabs)
panels.why: the silk's top edge cuts open far ground with bare trees and pines (map: S5.grd.far_bank_6250, the far trees); the panel carries only that ground and those two kinds of tree on into the mist. Its strip leaves out what is built in 3D or not painting: the bundle pile and back hall (u 5600-5900), the gate tower's roof (u 6420-7600), the collector's seal (u 8200-8460) and the far path's riders and house (u 8880-9400)
S6 (the inner city, u 2000-5600) lies past the west seam; shown only when the inner city is not loaded
